children: DTCC is connecting its tokenization service to Stellar, a move that positions the network to carry tokenized traditional assets through regulated market infrastructure. Tokenized assets are expected to arrive in the first half of 2027, with the integration announced for Q2 2027.

The connection makes XLM a direct settlement rail for tokenized traditional assets rather than a network serving crypto-native issuance alone. DTCC operates central infrastructure for US markets, so its tokenization service reaching Stellar gives the network a defined role in regulated asset flows. The first tokenized assets are not expected until H1 2027, so the practical effect depends on which assets DTCC routes to the network and at what volume. That timeline gives market participants a window to assess Stellar's emerging role in institutional settlement before live assets arrive.
